rationale: CPRI gapped up ~10.5% on an earnings beat but is now consolidating near 74.5% of today's range with price sitting just above VWAP and the 9-EMA, showing no clear directional momentum — the last five 1-minute candles show a tight, low-volume drift with no breakout or breakdown signal.
